documents.text: Full time employees accrue 15 days of paid time off per year. Unused days roll over up to a maximum of 5.
Remote work is allowed up to 3 days per week with manager approval. Core hours are 10am to 3pm local time.
The dress code is business casual. Client facing meetings may require formal attire.
